title: Repro reproduction card predicate, v0
description: The predicate of an in-toto Statement whose predicateType is https://github.com/DuhItzAniket/Repro/blob/main/docs/attestation/reproduction-card/v0.md (ADR-0012, H04). It records what Repro ran and observed for one change: the Reproduction Card as the run published it, its digest, the evidence the card cites as digested resource descriptors, and the event log's digest. It does not certify that the change is correct, and verdicts from language models are judgements. status, isolationLevel and network repeat the card's for policy engines; they always equal it.

cardDigest.description: SHA-256 of the card's canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8): the card_sha256 of the run's card.published.

eventLog.description: The run's event log up to its card: SHA-256 of its events as canonical JSON lines, and how many.

evidence.description: Each evidence record the card cites, by ID: SHA-256 of the record's canonical JSON.
